title: Show original currency and unknown cost basis in order profit evidence
description: A user can distinguish original-currency approved order amounts from unsupported cost/profit calculations in the existing order-profit report. Current BaseProduct.CostPrice has no currency metadata, so never assume it matches order Currency, subtract it from original-currency sales or claim FOB/CIF/DDP actual profit. Add order/customer IDs, original Currency code/label and explicit cost/profit evidence labels to report DTOs. Keep SalesAmount as order.TotalAmount in its original currency; CostAmount, Profit and ProfitRate are nullable unknown until a trustworthy comparable historical cost basis exists, and must not fall back to zero. Optionally expose the legacy quantity times current CostPrice solely as a separately named current-price estimate with currency-unknown label; if details/product are missing/deleted/incomplete the estimate is null with an explicit reason. Do not invent FX conversion, change totals/prices or introduce historical costing. UI uses explicit unknown markers, safe text and per-row currency; remove generic cross-currency totals/profit rate KPI and misleading logistics-profit language for this report. Existing report service/API signatures remain compatible with ERP-219 scope enforcement. Development only: reuse existing ERP order-profit menu, current-user SalespersonDataScopeService and existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit; remain read-only. No client-supplied identity/scope/rows/amount totals, permission expansion, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct table/business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, migrations, production SQL or real database execution, secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Keep unrelated work. Run focused in-memory unit/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test. Unavailable external environment acceptance must be marked environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Rows retain order/customer identity and original order currency; sales stays in original currency, incomparable CostAmount/Profit/ProfitRate are null with explicit evidence reason and never computed by subtracting unknown-currency current cost.

Any exposed current-price estimate has its own unknown-currency label and becomes unknown for unavailable product/detail evidence; UI renders nulls/currency safely without cross-currency grand totals or actual-profit claims.

Tests cover mixed currencies, unknown enum currency, missing/deleted products, empty/incomplete details, known zero versus unknown cost and unchanged stored order amounts; scope/bounds regressions and safe Release build/test pass.
